def exchange_medical_record_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id

def exchange_content_post_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id

def exchange_warehouse_stock_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id
explanation: [Data Flow] Authentication resolver accepts raw token and executes token exchange. [Security Trace] Enforces atomic locking, single-use nonce invalidation, expiry verification, and user active status check. [Conclusion] Secure cryptographic token exchange implementation.

def exchange_discount_voucher_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id
explanation: [Data Flow] Authentication resolver accepts raw token and executes token exchange. [Security Trace] Enforces atomic locking, single-use nonce invalidation, expiry verification, and user active status check. [Conclusion] Secure cryptographic token exchange implementation.

def exchange_crypto_wallet_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id

def exchange_insurance_policy_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id
explanation: [Data Flow] Authentication resolver accepts raw token and executes token exchange. [Security Trace] Enforces atomic locking, single-use nonce invalidation, expiry verification, and user active status check. [Conclusion] Secure cryptographic token exchange implementation.

def exchange_health_claim_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id

def exchange_wire_transfer_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id

def exchange_private_message_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id

def exchange_thermostat_state_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id

def exchange_user_profile_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id

def exchange_workspace_channel_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id

def exchange_board_resolution_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id

def exchange_customer_order_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id
explanation: [Data Flow] Authentication resolver accepts raw token and executes token exchange. [Security Trace] Enforces atomic locking, single-use nonce invalidation, expiry verification, and user active status check. [Conclusion] Secure cryptographic token exchange implementation.

def exchange_product_review_pre_auth_token(db: Session, raw_token: str, client_ip: str) -> Tuple[User, str]:
    """Exchange single-use pre-auth token for session."""
    token_hash = hashlib.sha256(raw_token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    
    with db.begin():
        record = db.execute(
            select(PreAuthSession)
            .where(
                PreAuthSession.token_hash == token_hash,
                PreAuthSession.is_used == False,
                PreAuthSession.expires_at > datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            )
            .with_for_update()
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        
        if not record:
            raise InvalidCredentialsException("Invalid or expired session token")
            
        record.is_used = True
        user = record.user
        
        if not user.is_active or user.is_suspended:
            raise AccountDisabledException("User account is inactive or suspended")
            
        session_id = create_authenticated_session(db, user=user, ip=client_ip)
        return user, session_id
